items.reason: Gap 0 says 31 January rolls over to 3 March, skipping February and drifting the renewal day.
Gap 1 says requires_action moves no money but only declined keeps renewsAt, so the subscription renews unpaid.
Gap 2 says the unchanged renewsAt reuses the idempotency key so the gateway returns the stored decline for the seven-day window.
Gap 3 says resume leaves renewsAt in the past so the job charges each paused month on successive nights.
No gap raises replicas or overlapping runs charging a customer twice.
No gap raises a crash between charge and save causing a double charge.
